identity_policy.commit: any reproducible full commit in declared repository; no allowlist
identity_policy.path: any canonical relative path; no allowlist
identity_policy.git_blob_oid: recomputed against exact supplied source bytes for integrity, not allowlist applicability
identity_policy.source_sha256: recomputed against exact supplied source bytes for integrity, not allowlist applicability

semantic_scope.selection: Tree-sitter C++ function definitions must resolve to an exact qualified owner+method name; no filename or revision is required. A missing/ambiguous owner, signature mismatch, parser error, unsupported effect, or unknown edge remains not_analyzed/partial/unknown.

rules.contract: Track the declared type-token origin and allocation target through bounded generated IR for StoreTypedArrayElement; compare argument 1 target against argument 4 token origin. Candidate evidence only.
Trace NewTypedArray(glue, input, type, count) result to LoadHClass(glue, object) and check whether its use can precede pending-exception handling; candidate evidence only.

model_input_policy: Only source bytes and parsed local syntax/IR facts are run-time inputs. Model contains declared method/signature and operation semantics; no exact target-source revisions, paths, Git blobs, source hashes, or dependency-source hashes.
partial_policy: A parser-incomplete source can be selected when the target method remains resolvable. Preserve partial/unknown observations and obligations; never infer safe/miss.
limitations: Tree-sitter syntax only; no preprocessing, compiler configuration, type system, whole-program data flow, runtime reachability, shipped product binding, or CIA impact proof.
Build profile assumption NDEBUG=1 and ENABLE_ASM_ASSERT=0 remains unverified.
The operation semantics originated in development material and have not been independently revalidated against changed helper implementations.
The selector may not find a target whose syntax is too damaged to resolve; such an input is not evidence of non-applicability or safety.
